remarks: Situated just moments from town, the train, schools, restaurants and shops, 349 Ponus Ridge offers one level living at its finest. The open floor plan consists of a formal living and dining room with stone fireplace, updated eat in kitchen with vaulted ceiling and exposed beams. The large primary suite has views of the backyard with full bathroom, walk in closet and laundry room. Two double bedrooms share a hall bath. A blue stone patio leads to the private backyard that has plenty of space for play, outdoor dining, and entertaining. Attached one car garage. Auxiliary generator adds peace of mind.
